name: Plaid
description: Plaid calls itself "the world's largest financial data network," enabling companies to connect to financial institutions and build fintech solutions on top of verified account and transaction data.
best_for: Plaid targets fintech companies, banks, lenders, payment processors, and organizations in consumer lending, insurance, healthcare, and gaming that need to build financial products.

tiers.name: Sandbox
tiers.notes: Free test-data environment with no live bank data; unlimited use for building and testing integrations.

tiers.name: Trial
tiers.notes: New US/Canada teams get free production access to real bank data, capped at 10 connected accounts total; removing an account does not free up the cap.

tiers.name: Pay-as-you-go
tiers.unit: per API call or per connected account
tiers.notes: No minimum commitment; exact per-call/per-account rates are not published and only appear after applying for production access.

tiers.name: Growth
tiers.notes: Requires a 12-month commitment and a minimum spend not publicly disclosed; adds discounted rates and dashboard SSO.

tiers.name: Custom/Enterprise
tiers.notes: Sales-negotiated; adds beta product access, volume discounts, and dedicated account management.

cons: No public pricing exists for any paid tier — Plaid's own pricing page and billing docs require applying for production access before any rate is shown, and the Growth/Custom tiers require talking to sales.
The free Trial is hard-capped at 10 connected accounts for the life of the team, and removing an account does not restore capacity toward that cap, per Plaid's own billing documentation.
Growth and Custom tiers require a 12-month minimum-spend commitment; only the Pay-as-you-go tier is commitment-free, and it carries the least favorable per-unit rates.
features: Bank connections across 12,000+ financial institutions in 20 countries
Account and routing number verification (Auth product)
Identity verification / KYC and anti-fraud tools
Categorized transaction and investment data (up to 24 months)
Fraud-prevention network built on aggregated data points

alternatives.name: Stripe
alternatives.description: A payments and financial-infrastructure API for accepting payments and managing billing/subscriptions.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses that need to actually process payments (cards, ACH, subscriptions) rather than just access bank data.

alternatives.name: Twilio
alternatives.description: Provides identity/verification APIs (Verify, Lookup) that overlap partially with Plaid's identity-verification use case.
alternatives.best_for: Companies needing phone-based identity verification or fraud signals alongside bank-data verification.
